readerCopy.headline: The room gets bigger, and so does the question of who gets to lead.
readerCopy.body:
Someone else may arrive with a bigger plan, stronger backing, or more confidence than you expected. You can be impressed and still disagree. A shared project may suddenly need a clearer decision about who leads which part because both people can see a convincing way forward.

Jupiter opposing Sun can make both sides certain they see the larger picture. Keep the disagreement on the decision. Who decides this part? What outcome are you trying to protect? What would each choice change? Respect does not require handing over your own direction.
